plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand badge, then the bottle, then the headline and subheadline, then the CTA at the far right. Each element is centred on the same middle line and the gaps between them are even.

Lead with the message: the headline and subheadline open the strip at the left edge. The bottle comes next, followed by the CTA, so the product sits right beside the action. The brand badge closes the strip at the far right.
Two halves: brand and message on the left (badge, then a wide text block), and product and action on the right (the bottle directly beside the CTA), separated by a deliberate band of breathing room.
